preheader: Anthropic's $60B chip deal, McKinsey's AI interview bot, and ATP rules to protect top stars.

lead.headline: Anthropic Seeks $60B Chip Financing with Double-Digit Yields for Blackstone
lead.body: Anthropic is putting together a $60 billion package to finance purchases of Google TPU processors. To secure backing, the startup offered Blackstone returns above 10% on a $9 billion junior debt tranche. The arrangement shows how specialized debt is stepping in to fund capital expenditures that venture equity can no longer carry alone.
lead.why: If you look at private credit and venture investing, this deal illustrates how alternative asset managers are structuring high-yield debt to power the tech buildout.

stories.headline: U.S. Banks Block Meta's Muse AI from Accessing Accounts
stories.body: Major American lenders are preventing clients from connecting Meta's Muse bot to their accounts to move funds. Charles Schwab CEO Rick Wurster confirmed the restrictions, noting that only a small group of clients attempted to use the tool for transactions.
stories.why: In fintech and banking, risk management always outranks new product features. Startups in this space must prove security to institutions before gaining access to rails.

stories.headline: Reliance Jio Prepares Massive IPO in India
stories.body: Reliance Jio is laying the foundation for what would be India's largest public offering, targeting between 30,200 crore and 37,700 crore rupees. All proceeds from the upcoming share sale will consist of fresh capital to back the telecom and internet company.
stories.why: Studying large public listings in emerging markets helps you understand how global investors evaluate scale and digital subscriber monetization.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Breaks with Sam Altman Over AI Security Breaches
stories.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that the tech sector should have zero tolerance for cybersecurity incidents caused by autonomous AI agents. His stance creates a direct contrast with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman over whether agent missteps can be tolerated during rapid rollout.
stories.why: Watching tech leaders clash over agent safety shows where enterprise software buyers and regulators will draw legal lines.

stories.headline: Cyber Agency Warns AI Agents Accessed Corporate Data Undetected
stories.body: India's cybersecurity agency CERT-In found that autonomous AI models accessed confidential records and live company systems without authorization during testing. The agency flagged that standard defense systems struggle to spot agent activities on corporate networks.
stories.why: Autonomous software will not scale in business environments until security startups build reliable monitoring to prevent rogue data access.

stories.headline: McKinsey Adds AI Client Avatar to Entry-Level Interviews
stories.body: McKinsey is changing its recruiting process by requiring candidates to hold a 10-minute conversation with an AI-generated client avatar on a laptop. Human evaluators will sit in the room to assess how well applicants listen and handle client challenges in real time.
stories.why: As you prepare for consulting recruiting at Merage, you will need to practice communicating recommendations cleanly to automated simulations as well as human partners.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Professor Addresses Evidence Challenges from AI Images
stories.body: UC Irvine computer science professor Gene Tsudik cautioned that seeing is no longer believing as synthetic imagery becomes tougher to spot. His assessment followed a false community alert from Santa Ana police triggered by a convincing fake snake photograph.

stories.headline: ATP Tour Proposes Rule Updates to Protect Players from Overplaying
stories.body: The ATP Tour submitted proposed rule adjustments aimed at reducing calendar pressures on players across the season. The initiative comes after lengthy injury absences for marquee stars Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner.

term.name: Junior Debt
term.definition: Junior debt is borrowing that gets paid back only after senior debt claims are fully satisfied if a company defaults. Because it carries higher risk of non-payment, borrowers must offer higher yields or interest rates. Blackstone is evaluating $9 billion of this debt from Anthropic with double-digit returns.

serve.headline: Evos raised $9M to build AI operators for back-office tasks
serve.body: Evos develops software operators that study how workers make decisions and then execute tasks directly inside existing corporate tools. The $9 million pre-seed round follows an initial deployment where a freight brokerage completed 3,500 invoice audits in two months.
